title: BPBond 솔로 #138 · 브라질부티글램 · Yoruba adire eleko pattern · 금 세트 벽 구속 · a deep wine-red glossy lip
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a medieval stone dungeon torture chamber with rough-cut stone block walls on each side of her, a low vaulted stone ceiling, iron torch sconces with flickering flames on the walls, old iron tools hanging on the stone wall, a damp flagstone floor, dark and moody firelight, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking in from one side, sharp focus from head to toe, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Subject: ONE real adult Yoruba Nigerian woman in her early 20s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, rich deep brown skin with a golden highlighter on the cheekbones, warm gold and bronze eyeshadow blended up to the brow bone, sharply defined arched brows, a precise winged liner, long dramatic lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a deep wine-red glossy lip, a large sculpted gele head-wrap of stiff gold-and-cream fabric folded high above her head, a poised, joyful, radiant expression, cheerful, sleek straight hair, real living eyes. Long almond nails, chrome finish.

Physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, her hips and rear so wide. A dramatically narrow, sharply cinched waist sits above hips and a rear so massively rounded and projecting that they dominate her entire silhouette from every angle — the rear itself curving outward and upward in a high, rounded, gravity-defying shape. A full round bust above the cinched waist, gigantic thick thighs meeting the rear's curve, thick soft arms. Her head looks small on top of her body. Not a plus-size model, not evenly proportioned. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Skin: Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a smooth taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh folds, faint stretch marks where the great curves have expanded. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Body Art: Her bare skin is painted in Yoruba adire eleko pattern — a deep indigo ground with bold cream resist-painted geometric motifs, wide cream bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense geometric bird motifs filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge. The paint covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.

Restraints: She wears a wide polished gold neck ring closed with a thick gold pin, with a heavy gold ring at the front, snug around her neck, from which a heavy chain of chunky thick polished gold links, each link as thick as a thumb, runs to a large polished gold ring bolted into the stone wall at head height beside her. Her wrists wear wide polished gold shackles, hinged bands closed with a thick gold pin, each with a heavy gold ring, each ring linked by a short chain of the same chunky polished gold links, up and outward to its own large polished gold ring bolted into the stone wall high on its own side, her arms stretched fully straight in a wide V above her head. Her ankles wear wide polished gold shackles, hinged bands closed with a thick gold pin, each with a heavy gold ring, each ring linked by a short chain of the same chunky polished gold links, down and outward to its own large polished gold ring bolted into the base of the stone wall on its own side.

Pose: standing full height between the two walls, facing the camera, her arms stretched fully straight in a wide V above her head, her legs spread apart, her chest, shoulders and stomach fully in view.

Footwear: Extreme cream sculptural heels, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Background & Lighting: the dim torchlight and flickering light catching the painted pattern in sharp glints, carving every fold and curve.

Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide. portrait 2:3 vertical.
